chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad al-Kufi, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad al-Nahdi, from Muhammad ibn al-Walid, from Aban ibn 'Uthman, from Isma'il ibn 'Abd al-Rahman al-Ju'fi, from Abu Ja'far عليه السلام.
Concerning a slave-girl jointly owned between two men,

and one of them, to the exclusion of the other, had intercourse with her and made her pregnant. He عليه السلام said: “He is to be given half of the hadd punishment, and he is to be made liable for half of the value.”

key_terms.فَأَحْبَلَهَا: he caused her to become pregnant
key_terms.نِصْفَ الْحَدِّ: half of the prescribed hadd punishment

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if one of two co-owners has intercourse with a jointly owned slave-girl and she becomes pregnant?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about a jointly owned slave-girl when one partner alone has intercourse with her and she becomes pregnant. The ruling states that the man receives half of the hadd punishment and must also pay half of her value, reflecting both penal and financial liability in this case.
